attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.effect: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

abilities.name: Baby Evolution
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put Wobbuffet from your hand onto Wynaut (this counts as evolving Wynaut) and remove all damage counters from Wynaut.

abilities.name: Peppy Pick
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a random card from your opponent’s hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.
